capabilities: Turn Markdown notes into flashcards with cloze, multiple choice, typed answers and image occlusion
Schedule reviews with FSRS learning steps, daily limits, custom study and an optimizer
Run timed exams with question maps, pass marks and saved progress
Generate cards from notes with an AI provider and review them before adding
Import and export Anki decks (.apkg) with media and schedules
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The plugin otherwise works offline; AI features are optional and off by default, with API keys kept in Obsidian's secret storage. Beta versions are installable via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Coming from Spaced Repetition? Disable it and enable Flashcard Studio. Your cards and schedules work as they are.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in spaced repetition, and the existing Spaced Repetition plugin lacks review history, daily limits, card control, exams, image occlusion and a desktop study interface.

relations.evidence: reads and writes the same note format as the Spaced Repetition plugin, so your existing cards
Import .apkg and text files with their media and decks, and export back to Anki.
The memory model is FSRS, through the ts-fsrs library.

summary: Spaced repetition flashcard plugin that turns Markdown notes into flashcards with FSRS scheduling, review history, statistics, exams and AI card generation.
